restrictions: The online algorithm only loads and verifies one pinned pair of distinct 128-byte messages. It has no fresh generator and makes no claim about historical wall time, fresh success frequency, or peak RSS.
Complete standard-IV MD5 with RFC 1321 padding, all steps 0 through 63 on every padded block, feed-forward after each compression, and all 128 digest bits.

All historical construction work, failed internal attempts represented by the published average, conversion to v3 word-RAM operations, verification, code, tables, messages, and retained advice are charged through the stated resource envelope and explicit heuristics.
The returned pair is nonuniform advice produced before online replay. Its construction is charged as preprocessing; repeated experiment rows are transport replays, not independent samples.
The baseline_improved value identifies the required nominal reference and does not assert an established attack baseline, novelty, rigorous qualification, or human acceptance.

heuristics.statement: All work that produced the retained pair, including differential-path preparation, the birthday search, near-collision construction, failed attempts represented by the published average, assembly, and verification, fits below 2^62 v3 charged units, and fewer than 2^55 construction items were processed.
heuristics.scope: Only the historical construction of the exact retained Table 6-7 pair and the submitted time_log2, preprocessing_log2, and data_log2 fields. The deterministic online replay and exact digest equality do not depend on this premise.
heuristics.extrapolation: The primary construction reports approximately 2^53.2 MD5 compression calls for the dominant useful birthday search and approximately 2^40.8 for the near-collision phase. The submitted 2^62 envelope adds a factor of approximately 2^8.8 for model conversion, unitemized word operations, failed internal work represented by the average, message assembly, and verification; the 2^55 data envelope exceeds 2^53.2 by more than a factor of three.
heuristics.limitations: There is no fresh executable generator, complete historical job ledger, instruction trace, or accounting of every unsuccessful development run. Compression-equivalent estimates are not definitionally identical to v3 units. If total historical work reached 2^62 units or construction items reached 2^55, the claim and score would fail. The fixed-witness experiment provides no cost evidence. Exploratory premise only.

heuristics.statement: Peak simultaneous algorithm memory during construction of the retained pair was below 2^30 bytes, including tables, code, constants, differential-path data, buffers, working state, allocator effects, and retained output.
heuristics.scope: Only the peak-memory field for one implementation of the published construction of the retained pair. It is not a claim about aggregate installed RAM across parallel machines or about the replay container's configured limit.
heuristics.extrapolation: The primary construction reports 400 MB of storage for the dominant birthday phase. The 2^30-byte envelope leaves more than 673 million decimal bytes beyond that figure for all other simultaneously live algorithm state.
heuristics.limitations: The reported storage is not accompanied here by a peak-RSS trace, allocation ledger, or proof that every concurrently live buffer was included. If simultaneous algorithm state reached 2^30 bytes, the memory field and scalar score would fail. The fixed-witness experiment measures no construction memory. Exploratory premise only.

heuristics.statement: The published single-block chosen-prefix workflow and its reported resource regime apply to the exact 128-byte Table 6-7 pair retained by this candidate, rather than to an unrelated MD5 variant or collision class.
heuristics.scope: Binding of the retained messages and summarized construction to complete, standard-IV, 64-step MD5 and to the cited single-block chosen-prefix example. It does not establish historical resource use.
heuristics.extrapolation: The publication identifies the messages, shared digest, construction, and followed differential path in the same section. The organizer independently recomputes a full collision on the exact bytes in a pinned target implementation and isolated replay.
heuristics.limitations: Fixed-witness agreement establishes target compatibility and collision existence, not replay of the historical generator, historical cost, or fresh success probability. The proof summarizes rather than reimplements the full differential-path search. Exploratory premise only.
